title: Empirical Evaluation of Policy-Based Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Service Control in an M/M/1 Queue
summary: While reinforcement learning has been increasingly applied to stochastic control, few studies have systematically examined policy-based methods in queuing environments modeled as a semi-Markov decision process (SMDP). To address this gap, we investigate how policy-based reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms perform when applied to the control of service rates in an M/M/1 queue, a common queuing model for manufacturing, computing, and service systems.
